Halfling

Quiet feet, a generous table and courage that surprises people who judge by height.

Rules

Choose two of the five traits below. These are invitations to a familiar fantasy, not a required personality. Any ancestry may grow up in any culture.

Starting values: HP +1; base Speed 5.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.23cbb6b6a4ee0b6e.JournalEntryPage.5d6933a5da46e615]{Bigger on the Inside} — Your knees may shake. Your friends will never see you leave them. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.32afe77bcb9f00a1.JournalEntryPage.b39265b53fcf58e8]{Under Their Noses} — The grand folk rarely remember to look beneath the table. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.cba4ce77e3253c0a.JournalEntryPage.69c266abd0aebc93]{Quiet as a Burrow} — You learned to come home late without waking the household. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.f9c4afe42a2e6b5d.JournalEntryPage.c33f980179b59773]{A Little Luck} — The latch catches your coat a heartbeat before you step into trouble. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.8bbd8025fa76f820.JournalEntryPage.4add1f263e38864d]{Second Breakfast} — You know how to make a small comfort last.

Starting coin contribution: +0 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
